definitions.explanation: Receiving money or benefits one is entitled to, such as a pension, unemployment benefits, or public assistance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}{資格|しかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

{受給|じゅきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遅|おく}らせる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{年金額|ねんきんがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: If you delay the age at which you start receiving it, your monthly pension increases.

notes:
An administrative word, common in news and on official forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{年金|ねんきん}→年金：04695_nenkin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to receive a pension
- {受給|じゅきゅう}{資格|しかく}: eligibility (for benefits)
- {受給者|じゅきゅうしゃ}: recipient, beneficiary
- ⟦{生活保護|せいかつほご}→生活保護：31465_seikatsuhogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受給|じゅきゅう}: receiving public assistance

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{需給|じゅきゅう}→需給：05920_jukyuu⟧ (supply and demand).
